title: Using Codex on a mining sim: testing a save while the crane load is still in the air
author: Igor_Indie_Warrior
selftext:
I'm making MARGIN: Raj Minerals, a mining management game with office visitors and hands-on jobs. I use Codex for implementation and testing assistance, plus AI image generation for art. I set the direction and review what goes into the game.



One concrete check in the Windows build was closing the game during the crane minigame, then reopening it and checking that the suspended load and game state were restored. Saving the cash total alone wouldn't cover that.



For the visuals, the project uses one approved reference and a fixed blue, cream and yellow palette. Generated assets are checked at the size they actually appear in the game.



These checks don't settle whether the opening days are fun. A full native playthrough and fresh-player pacing checks are still ahead. That's where I'm keeping the focus now.
